caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal lantern with a conical top and a circular loop handle attached at the peak for hanging. The lantern is colored in muted shades of gray and green, suggesting a metal material, possibly tin. The surface of the lantern is covered evenly with small, symmetrical star-shaped perforations, likely intended for ventilation or light emission. A rectangular, hinged door with a small latch is visible on one side of the body, providing access to the interior. The base and top edges are slightly flared outward, and the structure appears seamless apart from the door. The background is a plain off-white or beige with no other objects present.
title: Pierced Tin Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
